data.title: Regeneron Wins FDA Nod For Livsayis, 4x-Year GMG Shot
data.description: The FDA approves Regeneron's Livsayis as the first siRNA therapy for adults with generalized myasthenia gravis, requiring four annual doses.

data.title: Target Analysts Boost Their Forecasts Following Better-Than-Expected Q3 Earnings
data.description: Target beat Q3 estimates, raised FY2026 sales and EPS forecasts, while analysts lifted price targets; shares fell 0.8%.

data.title: Andreas Halvorsen’s Viking Global Reverses Tesla Cut, Boosts Stake 327% — Exits Microsoft, SpaceX and Qualcomm In Q3
data.description: Andreas Halvorsen’s Viking Global boosts Tesla 327% in Q3 while exiting Microsoft, SpaceX and Qualcomm.

data.title: These Analysts Boost Their Forecasts On Palo Alto After Upbeat Q1 Results
data.description: Palo Alto Networks beat Q1 estimates, raised FY27 guidance above forecasts, and shares jumped 9.5% as analysts lifted price targets.

data.title: NetEase Downbeat Q3 Results, Joins Red Robin, Sellas Life Sciences And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Thursday’s Pre-Market Session
data.description: U.S. stock futures rose, but NetEase slid 5.2% after missing Q3 earnings and sales estimates; Red Robin and Sellas also fell sharply premarket.
